description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thibirigaswewa, Hingurakgada D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District - Cad. Map No. 120101
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed determinations of land ownership for specific parcels, including parcel numbers, extent measurements, owner information, and land classifications. The content focuses entirely on land administration, property rights, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
